subcategory.description: Short label, e.g. 'CRM', 'Helpdesk', 'Ads platform', 'Web scraping API'.

auth_methods.description: Every way a third-party developer can authenticate to the public API. bearer_token = personal access / static token. api_key = key passed as header or query param.

auth_primary.description: What an agent toolkit acting for many end users would use.

access.description: Can a developer get working credentials alone, today? self_serve_free = free account/tier gives API access. self_serve_trial = only via a time-limited trial. paid_plan_required = API needs a paid plan. approval_required = app review / developer-token / admin approval before real use. partner_gated = partnership program required. contact_sales = enterprise/sales only. no_public_api = none exists.

access_notes.description: Exactly what gates it (plan name, review step, scope approval) and for what (dev vs production/public distribution).

api_breadth.description: broad = many resources, CRUD across the product (roughly 50+ operations). moderate = core objects covered (roughly 10-50). narrow = a handful of endpoints or one function.

api_breadth_notes.description: Main resources covered, and an operation count if the docs make one countable.

webhooks.description: Does the API push events (webhooks / event subscriptions)? Needed for agent triggers.

mcp.description: official_remote = vendor-hosted MCP server URL. official_local = vendor-published MCP package you run. community_only = only third-party servers.

mcp_notes.description: URL or package name of the MCP server, if any.

sandbox.description: Free developer sandbox / test mode / dev account distinct from production.

buildability.description: Could Composio ship an agent toolkit for this today? ready_now = public API + self-serve creds. ready_with_caveats = buildable but something slows it (app review for public OAuth, paid plan, narrow API). needs_partnership_or_sales = blocked on a business conversation. not_buildable = no usable API.

url.description: A page you actually fetched or saw in results. Prefer the vendor's own docs.

quote.description: Short verbatim text from that page that supports the claim (under 30 words).

needs_human.description: Empty string if nothing. Otherwise what a human must check and why (login wall, ambiguous product identity, conflicting docs).
